the_two_rules_that_cannot_both_stand: noise modal_count 5 -> r_confirm_B = 14, i.e. buy more trials when the endpoint is noisy
target positive requires every one of the r_confirm_B trials to return the expected relation
incompatibility.why_they_conflict: under unanimity, increasing r does not absorb trial-level variability; it strictly increases the number of agreements required. The extension branch can never turn a noisy endpoint into a positive
incompatibility.worked_example: six calls with five expected and one dissent already fail a six-trial unanimity target, and fourteen trials demanding fourteen agreements fail harder

target_pair.statement_a: Caution is warranted when the conclusion rests on information I have not seen myself.
target_pair.statement_b: the view that a finding depending mainly on secondhand report is to be held with reserve

target_preserved.target_positive_requires: planned target trials all legal AND every relation token equals the expected relation

stability_gate.rule: the noise pilot is a STABILITY GATE: it never enlarges the target sample

pass.condition: all six trials legal AND the unique modal token's count equals 6 (all six agree with each other)

self_noise_inconclusive.condition: all six trials legal BUT the unique modal count is 5 or lower, including any unique-modal tie

invalid_inconclusive.invalid_policy: the frozen invalid policy applies unchanged

stability_gate.why: the six calls must agree with EACH OTHER; the gate deliberately does NOT require the modal token to equal the fixture's pre-registered expected relation, because agreement is a property of the executor while correctness is a property of the fixture — the D2 neutral pilot established exactly this distinction

superseded_branch.why_retired: it suits a modal-based confirmation criterion, where extra trials can outvote noise, and is incompatible with the frozen unanimity target scorer

request_identity.request_bytes_source: the exact model-facing request frozen during D3-B qualification for this fixture, reused verbatim
request_identity.hash_source: the D3-B qualification evidence's fixture request artifact

noise_request.frozen_request_hash_source: the D3-B qualification evidence's fixture request artifact

prior_exposure.the_new_six_calls_are: a prospectively frozen independent calibration batch
prior_exposure.limitation_stated_plainly: the selected calibration request HAS already been observed during qualification; it must not be described as a never-before-seen calibration stimulus
prior_exposure.what_this_does_not_undermine: the gate reads agreement among the six new calls, and prior exposure cannot make six identical answers more or less agreeing than they are
